name: ARB_REG_USER_PROFILES
description: This table stores the Bill Management user information provided during registration.

columns.name: REG_USER_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Registration user identifier.

columns.name: FIRST_NAME
columns.description: First name of the user.

columns.name: LAST_NAME
columns.description: Last name of the user.

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: E-mail address of the user.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the user login.

columns.name: REG_STATUS
columns.description: Identifies the user status.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: The batch number of the user registration upload batch.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Person party identifier of the user. A foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table.

columns.name: JOB_TITLE
columns.description: Job title of the user.

columns.name: PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: International country code for a telephone number. For example, 33 for France.

columns.name: PHONE_AREA_CODE
columns.description: The area code within a country code.

columns.name: PHONE
columns.description: A telephone number formatted in the local format. The number should not include area code, country code, or extension.

columns.name: PHONE_EXTENSION
columns.description: Additional number addressed after initial connection to an internal telephone system.

columns.name: LAST_LOGIN_DATE
columns.description: Date and time of last login by the user.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
